testcase.name: the workflow identity is derived from the signature, not from an unsigned header()
a signed delivery id de-duplicates an event even when the sender re-signs the retry()
the replay record is keyed by signature - the same signature never passes twice, different requests do()
the canonical route and the body limit()
the replay record outlives the window in which a signature is acceptable()
the delivery id of a v2 signature cannot be changed or removed()
v1 and v2 signatures cannot be converted into each other()
a repeated protocol header is dropped, so the request fails authentication()
a tenant named in the body or in headers is ignored - the endpoint decides()
a replayed request is audited by id and reason only()
a captured request replayed with another delivery id is still a replay()
a failed delivery releases both replay records so the sender's retry goes through()
